integrity: The averaging equations are derived directly from the operator identity on the basis {1, epsilon}; the two-plane decomposition is solved exactly; the automorphism action is computed explicitly; and a standalone checker independently verifies the symbolic equations and finite-field orbit counts.
scientific_limitations: The theorem fixes the dual-number multiplication and classifies averaging operators only up to automorphisms of that algebra.
It does not classify averaging operators on every two-dimensional associative algebra.
A specialized or unindexed source may contain an equivalent concrete classification.
title: Averaging operators on the dual numbers form two planes
